item.title: Reliance Industries Q3 Results: Net profit Rs 1,865 crore, EBITDA margins shrink; Top highlights here
item.description: Reliance Industries posts steady Q3FY26 profit despite rising costs and margin pressures. Revenue jumps over 10%, but EBITDA margins shrink. What’s behind RIL’s resilient growth in a challenging market?

item.title: NDA’s bond with people of Maharashtra deepened further: PM Modi hails BMC poll verdict
item.description: Mahayuti sweeps Maharashtra civic polls, but what does this mega win reveal about the NDA’s connection with the people? PM Modi hails the victory, praises party workers, and claims it reflects voters’ trust in development and governance.

item.title: Weather Update: Severe cold wave and dense fog grip North India; Snowfall in hills
item.description: North India continues to reel under a severe cold wave accompanied by dense fog, severely affecting daily life and transport. According to the India Meteorological Department, visibility dropped to zero in several parts of Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Chandigarh.

item.title: Gold prices fall for second straight day, Silver also declines; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India fell for the second consecutive day, tracking weakness in global markets. In Delhi, 24-carat gold slipped to ₹143,540 per 10 grams, while silver prices also declined. International gold prices eased amid a stronger dollar and easing geopolitical tensions.

item.title: BMC Election Results: Kangana Ranaut calls Uddhav Thackeray camp’s defeat “Justice Served”
item.description: The BMC Election 2026 results have reshaped Mumbai’s political landscape, with the BJP–Shinde alliance securing a clear majority. Reacting to the defeat of the Shiv Sena (UBT), BJP MP and actor Kangana Ranaut termed the outcome “justice.”

item.title: Indians evacuated from Iran amid protests; Describe situation as ‘very bad’
item.description: Amid escalating protests in Iran, several Indian nationals have safely returned to India, sharing accounts of worsening conditions, internet shutdowns, and street demonstrations. Returnees credited the Indian government and the Indian Embassy in Tehran for timely advisories and evacuation support.

item.title: Donald Trump seals deal with Venezuela; US to buy 50 million barrels of oil
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced a major energy deal with Venezuela under which the United States will purchase 50 million barrels of crude oil worth about $5.2 billion. Trump said the proposal came from Venezuelan authorities facing storage issues.

item.title: Mauni Amavasya: Prayagraj braces for largest Snan as millions of devotees arrive
item.description: Prayagraj Magh Mela is set to witness an unprecedented turnout on Mauni Amavasya, with nearly 3.5 crore devotees expected to take a holy dip. The administration has expanded bathing ghats, strengthened crowd management, and enhanced security measures.

item.title: Iran Unrest: Indians return home after days of fear and communication blackouts
item.description: Several evacuees described weeks of growing uncertainty, worsened by widespread internet shutdowns that cut them off from their families and diplomatic channels. “For the first few weeks, things were normal. But in the last one or two weeks, the situation changed completely.
